name: acf-whip
description: Continuous backlog automation with aggressive quality gates. /task decomposes a scope into atomic, dependency-aware tasks; /go orchestrates them to completion — dispatching parallel specialists in isolated git worktrees (one per task slug), running quality review, and integrating accepted branches into the trunk, looping until every task is accepted or blocked. Concurrency-safe (the git-worktree branch registry is the lock), self-healing via /whip-doctor, and run as deterministic dynamic workflows so Claude's context stays flat across long runs.
